receiverNormalRefutation.criterion: World geometric face normal.y > 0.01 identifies top-facing receiver candidates; face orientation is retained under DoubleSide raycasting.
receiverNormalRefutation.conclusion: No tested footprint point has an upward-facing surface at the prop base. One AC edge sample intersects the downward-facing bottom of a different debris primitive at the same base height under DoubleSide, which is not a supporting roof surface. This is a sampled geometric support finding, not an exhaustive contact-area calculation.

independentDataLens.sourceObservation: Terrace avoids a complete bay whenever its pre-gap span intersects a reserved interval; the realized southern mass gap around these props is wider than the nominal [-108,-92] interval. Roof scatter uses the zone y=10.05 and rejects collision overlaps, without measuring an underlying roof.
